# CraftCreator: 

## Commands:

/cc create (name) (ingredient) (quantity) (slot) (hand/Item that we get when crafting) - create a craft

/cc delete (name) - delete a craft

/cc list - list of crafts

**How the /cc create command works:**

1. ingredient means the item that needs to be put into the craft.
2. slots work like this https://files.catbox.moe/wb07rl.jpg
3. hand means the item that you hold in your hand when creating a craft.           
4. example of a working command: 
/cc create Test Diamond 1 2 GOLD_INGOT 1 8 Diamond 1 5 DIAMOND_SWORD
means that if we put the items like this: https://files.catbox.moe/ylg6v3.jpg then we will get a diamond sword.

## Another Info:
At the plugin are file "Crafts.yml" There are All crafts from the plugin.

At config you can Off all crafts and modify Messages.

**There are 1 bag Whith Count at ingrediens and because please make always 1 at the "(count)"**
